newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland and Denmark join Bosnian diplomatic freeze.
newsitem.headline: Finland and Denmark join Bosnian diplomatic freeze.

text.p: Finland and Denmark said on Tuesday they had joined countries suspending contacts with their Bosnian ambassadors, following a European Union recommendation.
The recommendation came earlier on Tuesday from Luxembourg as holder of the European Union's revolving presidency.

France, Britain, Sweden, Austria, Italy, Spain and Germany, all concerned by the faltering pace in implementing Bosnia's 1995 peace treaty, have already suspended contact, along with the United States.

The international community's High Representative in Bosnia, Carlos Westendorp, recommended the diplomatic freeze after Serb, Moslem and Croat leaders failed to meet an August 1 deadline for agreement on ambassadors.
